WARNING FOR ANY FUTURE AGENT - the WER monthly infected-areas list is printed in 4-6 columns and ordered by DISEASE. Assigning a country block to the nearest disease heading above it by LINE NUMBER is wrong. Under that naive reading Ugandas Western Region / Nebbi District entry looks like a cholera listing in every year from 1986 to 2001. It is PLAGUE - the West Nile focus - in all of them, as is Northern Region / Arua District from 1999. Pages must be segmented into column bands and re-serialised into reading order first.
